chars: the student in the white durag
moments.action: End of day in a crowded school corridor: the student in the white durag and a girl move with the crowd past the American student, who pushes the other way and by the last shot has stopped, scowling ahead.

chars: the long-haired man in the parka
moments.action: He walks out past the bicycle racks as students stream into the street; across the road an orange sports car is parked with the long-haired man in the parka leaning on it, and he pulls up short when he sees them.

chars: the long-haired man in the parka
moments.action: Shot and reverse at the kerb: the man in the parka talks calmly while the student answers tight-jawed. By the last shot the older man has closed the distance and is grinning at him.
The orange car pulls away from the high school gates, a low angle whips along its flank as it accelerates, then a wide of a quiet shopping street where it has already arrived far down the road.

chars: the long-haired man in the parka
moments.action: Inside the moving car the student watches the street go by, then turns as the driver talks across to him; the speed drops from blurred shopfronts to a slow roll through narrow backstreets.
The orange car stops outside an old tiled bathhouse and a cyclist crosses in front of it; the next shot is already inside, on the milk fridge, folded towels and empty reception desk.
In the bath hall a man lathers his hair at a low tap and others soak in the tiled pool, one huge tattooed back filling it. The student walks in wrapped in a towel and stops dead, taking the room in.
moments.censor_note: public bathhouse: bare male torsos and backs, towels covering below the waist; roughly a third of frame, incidental to the setting

moments.action: The student stares; a close-up finds a dark tattoo sprawled over the big bather's wet shoulder, and back on his face the look shifts from curiosity to recognition, mouth open.
moments.censor_note: close-up of a bare wet shoulder and upper back, no explicit content; fills most of one shot
